Convert a Seurat object to a Giotto object

Source: R/seurat.R
seuratToGiotto.Rd

Convert a Seurat object with the mapping that fits its structure. The object is profiled, the matching mapping is selected from those bundled with GiottoConnect (or the one given), and the conversion runs through convertWithMapping(). Object versions are handled by choosing a mapping, not by separate functions.

Usage

seuratToGiotto(sobject, mapping = NULL, source = NULL, verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

sobject

Seurat object

mapping

optional giottoMapping, mapping file or bundled mapping id. By default the bundled mapping that applies to sobject is used.

source

NULL for an in-memory giotto object, or a directory for a GiottoDisk-backed object

verbose

logical

Value

giotto object; see mappingProvenance() for what was converted and which losses apply

See also

findMapping(), convertWithMapping(), validateMapping()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("SeuratObject", quietly = TRUE)) {
    set.seed(1)
    counts <- Matrix::rsparsematrix(20, 30, density = 0.3,
        rand.x = function(n) stats::rpois(n, 5) + 1)
    dimnames(counts) <- list(paste0("gene", 1:20), paste0("cell", 1:30))
    s <- SeuratObject::CreateSeuratObject(counts)
    # coordinates kept as metadata columns are found as well
    s$x <- stats::runif(30, 0, 500)
    s$y <- stats::runif(30, 0, 500)
    g <- seuratToGiotto(s)
    g
    mappingProvenance(g)$losses
}
